name: Name
uploadPreview: Upload sprite / preview PNG, JPG or WebP
avatarDescription: The slot defines the avatar layer and prevents incorrect overlaps.
spriteDescription: Upload or replace the avatar item spritesheet.
textureDescription: Textures are lightweight: they do not collide and apply to floors or walls.
worldDescription: Footprint occupies tiles, surface allows stacking, and origin anchors the sprite on the map.
worldItemsDescription: Advanced configuration for furniture, decoration, NPCs and interactive objects.
walkableDescription: Users can walk on top of it.
rotatableDescription: It can be rotated inside the room.
interactableDescription: It can react to clicks or actions.
allowsStacking: Allows objects to be placed on top
canBeStacked: Can be placed on other objects
singleFaceHint: Uses the full image as a single frame instead of slicing it into 4. Useful for testing objects face by face. The item won't be rotatable in-game.
facesHint: How many views the horizontal spritesheet has. 1 = static image (no rotation). 2 = front and side (North/South use the 1st, East/West the 2nd). 4 = one view per rotation. The image width is divided by this number.
interactionsHint: What the player can do when clicking the object in-game. TOGGLE = turn on/off (TV, lamp). OPEN = open/close (door). SIT/LIE/DRINK affect the avatar's pose.
createWorldItemDescription: World items reuse the existing item flow. Create the base item first and then configure its world data from the list.
createTextureDescription: Create floor tiles or wall textures to sell in the shop.
loadItemsAnimationsError: Could not load items or animations
missingSpriteDataError: Missing data: image, item and animation are required
dropzoneText: Drag the image here or click to select
confirmDeleteItem: Are you sure you want to delete this item?
invalidMaxStackError: The max purchase quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.
uploadSpriteRequiredError: You must upload a sprite or preview.
footprintTileRequiredError: Define at least one footprint tile.
onlyImagesForSpriteError: Only images are allowed for Item Sprite.
readOnlyModeNotice: Read-only mode: you can inspect all technical data without modifying the object.
coinsHint: Price in in-game coins. Example: 100 coins.
maxStackHint: Max units a player can own of this item -- also the max they can buy in a single purchase. 1 = single-unit purchase only (default). Higher values let players pick a quantity and buy several units at once in the shop.
gemsHint: Not functional yet -- there is no gem currency implemented. Kept only for data compatibility.
rarityRangeHint: Allowed range for this rarity: {min}-{max} coins
rarityHint: Sets the border color of the item in the inventory and shop.
languageHint: Language of this item's name and description.
slotHint: Body part where the item is equipped. Determines the draw layer (e.g. keeps a hat from rendering behind the hair).
animationHint: Avatar animation state this sprite is shown for (e.g. idle, walk).
frameWidthHint: Width in pixels of each frame in the spritesheet.
frameHeightHint: Height in pixels of each frame in the spritesheet.
framesHint: Total number of frames in the animation row.
rowHint: Spritesheet row this animation is on (0 = first row).
textureKindHint: Whether the texture applies to the floor or the wall.
worldKindHint: Functional category of the object: furniture, decoration, NPC or interactive.
placementTypeHint: Where it can be placed inside a room: floor, wall or both.
footprintWidthHint: Number of tiles the object occupies across.
footprintHeightHint: Number of tiles the object occupies deep.
stackHeightHint: Visual height (px) this object adds when something is placed on top.
maxStackHeightHint: Maximum accumulated height allowed when stacking objects on this one.
noBodyItemFound: No BODY item has been created yet
configureSpriteElsewhereHint: The animated sprite (with real body preview and all 8 directions) is configured in the dedicated editor.
fpsHint: Only controls the animation speed in this preview — it doesn't affect how it looks in-game, it's just so you can review the frames comfortably.
spriteEditModeNotice: Editing the saved sprite for {item} ({animation}, {direction}). The values below are already the saved ones — upload an image only if you want to replace it.
spriteCreateModeNotice: This item/animation/direction doesn't have a saved sprite yet — a new one will be created on save.
frameGeometryHint: How the sheet is cut into frames: size of each frame, how many there are and which row is used.
playbackPreviewHint: Only affects this preview window, not how it looks in-game.
effectKeyHint: Which @codebuddies/visual-effects effect this item unlocks. One item per effect.
effectItemDescription: A cosmetic item that unlocks one Premium visual effect for the buyer to use as their Name Effect. Purchasable, giftable, and grantable as a Battle Pass reward.
spriteOffsetHint: Fine pixel adjustment of how the image sits on the tile, per direction. It does not change the footprint, collision or anchor: it only nudges the sprite to compensate for how the art was exported.
spriteOffsetResetConfirm: Reset the sprite offset back to 0, 0 for every direction?
spriteOffsetKeyboardHint: With a row focused: arrows = 1 px · Shift + arrows = 10 px.
spriteOffsetQuickNote: Quick editor: applies the same offset to all 4 directions. To tune each rotation separately, use the item editor.
behaviorDescription: Define what the object does: its states, its animations and what happens on click.
behaviorStaticHint: The object will always look the same, with no animation or interaction.
behaviorStatesHint: The situations the object can be in: off, on, open...
behaviorAnimationsHint: Upload the frames of each animation. They are merged into a single image automatically.
behaviorFramesDrop: Drag the frames (PNG) here or click to pick them
behaviorFramesExpected: Needs a multiple of {rows} files (one per facing)
behaviorTransitionsHint: What happens when a player clicks the object.
behaviorDuplicatedTransition: There is already another click action for this state.
behaviorValid: The behaviour is valid and ready to save.
behaviorPreviewUnavailable: Finish the setup to try it out.
behaviorPreviewAssetError: The animation could not be loaded.
behaviorStatusBodySTATIC: No states, no animations: it will always look the same.
behaviorStatusINVALID: Something is stopping this from being saved
behaviorStatusBodyINVALID: Check whatever is marked in red. Until it is fixed, the object cannot be saved.
behaviorStatusINCOMPLETE: You can save it, but it is not ready yet
behaviorStatusBodyINCOMPLETE: Save whenever you like. As it stands, it would not show up or work properly in the room.
behaviorStatusBodyREADY: In the room it will look and behave exactly like it does here.
behaviorStepENABLE: turn behaviour on if you want the object to move or react
behaviorStepFIX_ERRORS: fix whatever is marked in red
behaviorStepUSE_ANIMATION: use the animation in a state or in a click
behaviorNoticeANIMATION_WITHOUT_SPRITE: No frames uploaded yet: nothing will show up in the room.
behaviorNoticeANIMATION_SINGLE_FRAME: Only one frame, so it will not move. Upload more frames if you want movement.
behaviorNoticeANIMATION_UNUSED: No state and no click uses it: it will never play.
behaviorNoticeSTATE_DEAD_END: Once it reaches this state no click gets it out: the object stays like this forever.
behaviorNoticeSTATE_UNREACHABLE: It is not the starting state and nothing leads to it: it will never be seen in the room.
behaviorNoticeNO_INTERACTION: Nothing reacts to click: the object will move, but players will not be able to do anything with it.
behaviorNoticeNO_ANIMATION: There is no animation: for now it looks just like a static object.
behaviorClickPlayThenBack: Plays {animation} once and goes back to how it was.
behaviorClickIncomplete: This interaction is not finished yet.
behaviorTransitionNoFrom: Pick the state this click works from.
behaviorNoStatesEmpty: No states yet. A state is a situation the object can be in: off, on, open…
behaviorNoAnimationsEmpty: No animations yet. An animation is the frames of one movement — the screen turning on, the water pouring: you draw them in your usual tool and only upload them here.
behaviorNoTransitionsEmpty: Nothing reacts to click. Add an interaction so the object changes when a player touches it.
behaviorAnimationUsedByNobody: No state and no click uses it yet.
behaviorDirectionalLocked: This object has a single face, so it is not needed.
behaviorStaticWhen: The right choice for a table, a chair or a painting: things that neither move nor respond.
behaviorFramesHint: One PNG per frame, all the same size.
behaviorFramesOrder: This is the order they will play in.
behaviorFramesMissing: {count} more file(s) needed to complete the {rows} faces.
behaviorFramesTooMany: Too many frames: the maximum is {max} per animation.
behaviorFramesDone: Frames uploaded: {frames} for each of the {rows} face(s).
behaviorFramesReplace: It already has frames: uploading others replaces them.
behaviorPreviewTestHint: This is a simulation: it does not touch the object or the room.
behaviorPreviewBusy: It is in the middle of an animation: the click is ignored until it finishes.
behaviorPreviewNoSheetYet: This animation has no frames uploaded yet.
behaviorDeleteAlsoTransitions: {count} click interaction(s) will be deleted too.
behaviorDeleteAlsoStates: These states will be left without an animation: {states}.
behaviorDisableBody: {states} state(s), {animations} animation(s) and {transitions} interaction(s) will be deleted.
behaviorTemplatesHint: A template builds the states and interactions for you; after that you only upload your frames.
behaviorTemplateConfirmBody: It replaces everything you have set up now.
behaviorUnsavedBadge: You have unsaved changes in the object's behaviour.
furnitureTypeHint: Which section the object appears in, in the shop and build mode (chairs, tables, beds...).
roomsHint: Which rooms this object is listed under in the shop and build mode. You can pick several (a plant fits a living room and outdoors).
autoMirrorHint: Upload a single face and the second one is generated by flipping the image, so the object can rotate.
autoMirrorError: Could not generate the mirrored face. Try another image.
autoMirrorNeedsUpload: To use auto mirror, upload the single-face image again.
chatBubbleThemeHint: Which bubble color this item unlocks when bought. Premium still includes all of them.
chatBubbleItemDescription: An item that unlocks a chat bubble theme for the buyer (or gift recipient). The shop shows a live preview, so the image is optional.
upgradesHint: Sell the basic item and charge for extra features: each upgrade unlocks behavior states (e.g. the TV ships off and "Power on" unlocks ON). Players buy it once and it applies to all their copies.
upgradesNeedBehavior: First set up the item's behavior (states and clicks) and save it.
upgradesNeedStates: The behavior needs at least one state besides the initial one to sell it as an upgrade.
upgradeDeleteConfirm: Delete this upgrade? If someone already bought it, it gets deactivated and the state becomes free for everyone.
